```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(omnideconv)
```

```{r}
# count matrix
counts <- data.table::fread("/nfs/data2/huji_artificial_meat/deconvolution_data/external_sc_references/Wang2023/GSE205347_Complete_10x_cattle_normalized_counts_data.csv.gz")
mat <- as.matrix(counts[, -1])
rownames(mat) <- counts$V1

# column metadata
metadata <- data.table::fread("/nfs/data2/huji_artificial_meat/deconvolution_data/external_sc_references/Wang2023/GSE205347_Complete_10x_cattle_Metadata.csv.gz")
#normalized_counts <- data.table::fread("/nfs/data2/huji_artificial_meat/deconvolution_data/external_sc_references/Wang2023/GSE205347_Complete_10x_cattle_normalized_counts_data.csv.gz")
metadata$V1 <- gsub("-", ".",metadata$V1)


metadata <- metadata[metadata$V1 %in% colnames(mat), ]
nrow(metadata)

metadata <- metadata[match(colnames(mat), metadata$V1), ]
all(metadata$V1 == colnames(mat))

omnideconv::build_model_dwls(single_cell_object = mat,
                             cell_type_annotations = metadata$lables,
                             dwls_method = "mast_optimized",
                             path = "wang2023_dwls_signature",
                             verbose = T, ncores = 7)
```
